name: temporal
summary: No temporal class takes a lock of its own: every write of ^KG("tout"/"tin"/"bucket"/"tagg"/"tlast"/"edgeprop") is unlocked and, outside the ledger path, outside any transaction. The only locks on these paths are the shared ^IVG.AdjW(g) of the adjacency row writers (5 s, fail-open, Adjacency.cls:61-73), the eraser's ^IVG.AdjW shared (refusing), the interning locks (module 10), the ledger head lock on the ledger path (Ledger.cls:440-444), and IRIS's implicit row, unique-key and FK locks on the marked rdf_edges row. Counters use $Increment (atomic, P-0501); min/max, the HLL sketch, the latest index and the collision check are read-then-Set. PENDING-LIVE
